fomod.Name: Zenderal - Relentless Sword
fomod.Author: johnskyrim (records) / Zenderal (Enderal conversion)
fomod.Description:
Enderal: Forgotten Stories SE conversion of johnskyrim's Relentless Sword SE.
The original plugin cannot load in Enderal - it masters Dawnguard.esm, HearthFires.esm and Dragonborn.esm, and its recipes are gated on the Skyforge keyword and a Companions questline global, neither of which exists in Enderal. This plugin carries the same six swords with clean masters, Enderal shadowsteel-tier damage, forge recipes gated on the Smithing crafting talent, and dismantle recipes matching the rest of Forgotten Stories.
REQUIRES johnskyrim's Relentless Sword SE installed for its meshes and textures (CORE / runed branch). Disable its own "Relentless Sword SE - Johnskyrim.esp" - this plugin replaces it.
